Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full landscape RGB map image, EXACTLY1536x1024 pixels, true vertical top-down, north up, same pixel grid and extent as reference1. This is a flat ground texture for a separate Louvre3D model to be added later; do NOT draw the Louvre or any landmark.

REFERENCE ROLES: 1=pohja.png, the actual base map; retain its exact composition, simple flat cartographic shapes and colors. 2=maski.png, white is the ONLY permitted redesign area, black is protected. 3=jalanjalki.png, white rotated rectangle must be entirely EMPTY PAVING. 4=tarkistus-alue.jpg is a guide only: BLUE polygon=model footprint, RED outline=editable limit, PURPLE southeast=protected Notre-Dame area. Never draw colored guides in the result. 5=malli-nd-pohja.png is STYLE ONLY, showing the matching subdued beige paving and flat building footprints; do not copy its different geography.

Replace every object inside the model footprint with continuous empty level warm beige stone paving, softly and faintly textured like reference5. The footprint is860x360 pixels, rotated20.3degrees, corners approximately(427,193),(1234,492),(1109,831),(302,533). Fill this ENTIRE rotated rectangle: NO remaining Louvre wings, pyramids, gardens, roads, houses, fountains, water, courtyard outlines or landmarks inside. The rectangle will be covered by a separate3D model. No outline or border around the rectangle.

The long Rue de Rivoli currently crossing the footprint must detour immediately NORTH of it within the editable mask. Other roads meet the outside street network at exactly the old positions or terminate at the footprint boundary. Leave just a narrow15–25px paving margin around the footprint, not a giant empty plaza. Reposition nearby flat tan building footprints only within the white mask, matching the base's simple forms. To the LEFT/WEST continue the existing Tuileries muted olive lawn to the footprint's western edge; do not add trees, pools or paths alongside the footprint.

Preserve the SEINE river, riverbanks, riverfront road and Pont du Carrousel exactly where they are in reference1. Never paint into the river. All pixels outside mask2's white area must stay identical to reference1, especially the outer image edges and protected southeast corner. Do not alter the map extent, scale, orientation or crop. Streets and banks must connect invisibly across the mask edge.

Same limited palette and simple drawing as reference1: cream streets/paving, muted taupe flat building polygons, muted olive grass, gray-olive water, extremely thin brown linework. Absolutely NO perspective, standing facades, walls, trees, cast shadows, raised buildings, 3D objects, new monuments, small invented streets, text, names, compass, border, boats, vehicles, animals or moving objects. No Google imagery. Return only the complete finished map, without the masks or guide colors.
